title: NASA CEA — LOX / LH2, O/F 6.0, 1000 psia

source.documents: NASA RP-1311 Part I (1994) and Part II (1996)
source.retrieved_from: RocketCEA v1.2.3 documentation, which reproduces the program's own printed output verbatim
source.independence: Produced by the 2002 Fortran implementation of CEA. The provider under test is the v3 re-implementation (cea 3.3.4), so neither number in this comparison produced the other. Agreement between two implementations of the same method on the same published case is meaningful evidence; it is not a claim that either is experimentally correct.

case.chamber_pressure_note: 1000.0 psia, converted with the exact definitions of the pound-force and the inch
case.temperature_note: The source prints 90.18 K for O2(L) against the 90.17 K used here. The difference is immaterial and the reason is itself a Phase 5C finding: CEA models O2(L) with an assigned enthalpy, so neither value enters the calculation.

not_compared.label: Characteristic velocity  c*
not_compared.reason: RocketForge does not own a characteristic velocity. The source publishes one and NASA CEA returns one natively, but neither is RocketForge's answer until Phase 5E implements the equation, so no value is shown here.

not_compared.label: Specific impulse  Isp
not_compared.reason: Rocket performance belongs to engineering.nozzle (ADR-15) and is not implemented. Showing the provider's native Isp in a RocketForge comparison would present a provider oracle as a RocketForge result.

not_compared.label: Exit  γ
not_compared.reason: An exit-station quantity. This workspace owns the chamber state only; there is no expansion here to compare it against.

verification.note: The published values above are compared against RocketForge's own pipeline output. Nothing in RocketForge reads them to produce a result; the direction is always published value -> compare -> computed value.
